# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Reliability and performance**

## Highlights

The next 4.156 update improves mobile rendering, pixel-copy performance, and native resource reliability. Android texture rendering now follows display refresh, while image-pixel and HarfBuzz feature processing avoid unnecessary allocations.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering synchronized** — Texture rendering on Android now follows the display refresh cadence for smoother front-buffered updates. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered streams released correctly** — Corrects stream retention in front-buffered image handling so native resources are no longer held longer than required. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed pixel copies optimized** — Reduces overhead when copying image pixels through the managed API. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Feature decoding avoids native allocations** — Avoids allocating native feature strings while preserving the existing feature-decoding behavior. ([#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **WebGPU native implementation bundled** — Includes emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp in libSkiaSharp.a so consumers of the static native library receive the required WebGPU implementation. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
